interface.longDescription: Convert an attached JPEG, PNG or WebP logo or illustration into downloadable SVG paths. Preview the vector and source inline. Inputs must be under 5 MB, under 16 MP, with each dimension greater than 256 and less than 4096 pixels. Tracing may simplify fine details and text; editable fonts and exact reconstruction are not guaranteed. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Convert this attached logo into SVG.
